group_results.reason: The added branch requires later parser events, but the target exits after copying its first stream-start event.

build.reason: The recipe builds the library containing parser.c and links the target. The added branch has no compile-time guard; the previously questioned STACK_EMPTY argument is ignored by its macro.

input.reason: The target passes fuzzer supplied bytes after its two control bytes to the parser’s string input setter; that framing permits YAML input.

lifecycle.reason: On the established exit route, the target deletes the original event, parser, emitter, copied event and output buffer.

control_flow.reason: The harness checks a successful copy as though it were an error. Its first successful parse yields stream-start, so it jumps to cleanup before emission or later parsing.
